title: Ponyta Is Born Without Its Signature Fire

direction.premise: Newborn Ponyta lack their fiery mane and tail, which grow out about one hour after birth.
direction.audiencePromise: Watch a plain newborn Ponyta transform into the fiery Pokémon fans recognize.
direction.openLoop: What changes during Ponyta's first hour?
direction.payoff: About an hour after birth, Ponyta gains the fiery mane and tail behind its impressive appearance.
direction.engagementQuestion: Which look wins: plain foal or fiery Ponyta?

voice.instructions: Warm, quick, and conversational. Stress the contrast between the plain newborn and the fiery final look. Pause briefly before each visual reveal.

scenes.headline: BORN WITHOUT FIRE
scenes.narration: Ponyta is born without its signature fire.
scenes.caption: THE FIRE COMES LATER

scenes.headline: A PLAIN FOAL
scenes.narration: At birth, this Fire Horse can barely stand, with no mane or tail.
scenes.caption: NO FIERY MANE. NO FIERY TAIL.

scenes.headline: COUNTDOWN TO FIRE
scenes.narration: A one-hour countdown marks when the missing fire appears.
scenes.caption: THE TRANSFORMATION IS TIMED

scenes.headline: THE FLAMES GROW OUT
scenes.narration: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out.
scenes.caption: MANE AND TAIL: FINALLY HERE

scenes.headline: NOW IT LOOKS LIKE PONYTA
scenes.narration: The plain newborn now has an impressive, fiery appearance.
scenes.caption: THE ICONIC LOOK ISN'T THERE AT BIRTH

scenes.headline: WHICH LOOK WINS?
scenes.narration: Which look wins: plain foal or fiery Ponyta?
scenes.caption: PLAIN FOAL OR FIERY PONYTA?
